title: Cymatic Phi-NeRF: Quasi-Periodic Golden-Ratio Positional Encoding and 3D Nyquist Anti-Aliasing in Neural Radiance Fields
description: Analytical 3D Shannon-Nyquist bandwidth diagnostics, Diophantine harmonic phase-collision metric, and PyTorch volumetric NeRF benchmarks demonstrating +1.84 to +2.03 dB held-out test PSNR gains from quasi-periodic Golden-Ratio (Phi^k) positional encodings.
